feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 June 2026 4:12am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 03 June 2026 at 4:10am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Low to the west of Ireland, slowly moving to sea area Malin by midnight, with an associated weather front crossing the Irish Sea this morning followed by troughs tonight and tomorrow


##Wind##

West-southwest or southwest 3 or 4, backing south or south-southeast 5 or 6 this morning, occasionally 7 in places, veering southwest late morning or early afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building mostly moderate this morning, then occasionally rough in places.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from the southwest this morning, clearing to scattered showers by this afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in the rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest veering west 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 Thursday evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in places.


##Weather##

Showers or rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers or rain.
